faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Type Hype is an AI-powered content creation platform. With 5 different AI characters, 4 writing tones, and advanced style cloning technology, it generates your social media content in seconds.
faq.a2: Enter any Twitter account's username. The AI analyzes the last 100 tweets, extracts the writing style across 9 dimensions (word choice, humor, sentence structure, etc.), and lets you create new content in that style.
faq.a3: X/Twitter (Tweet, Quote, Reply, Thread, Article), Instagram caption, TikTok script, YouTube description, LinkedIn post, and Blog articles are supported.
faq.a4: Five distinct writing characters: Pure (authentic and simple), Authority (expert and authoritative), Insider (industry secrets), Mentalist (psychological hooks), and News (current events). Each writes with a unique voice.
faq.a5: Yes! The free plan gives you a limited number of daily generations. The Pro plan includes unlimited generation, all personas, full Style Lab access, and APEX mode.
faq.a6: Absolutely. Your data is encrypted, never shared with third parties, and never used for AI model training. Everything is completely under your control.

dataController.title: Data Controller
body: In accordance with the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK"), your personal data will be processed by TypeHype ("Company") as the data controller for the purposes stated below.

personalData.title: Collected Personal Data
body: The following personal data may be processed while using our services:
items: Identity Information: Username, full name
Contact Information: Email address
Transaction Security Information: IP address, session data, access logs
Marketing Information: Cookie data, preferences, usage statistics
Social Media Information: Connected social media account details (username, profile URL)

purposes.title: Processing Purposes
body: Your personal data is processed for the following purposes:
items: Managing membership and account operations
Providing the AI-powered content generation service
Improving service quality and developing new features
Personalizing user experience
Fulfilling legal obligations
Conducting information security processes
Performing statistical analyses

retention.title: Data Retention Period
body: Your personal data is retained for the duration required by the processing purpose and in accordance with legal retention periods.

Upon deletion of your account, your personal data will be permanently deleted from our systems within 30 days. Data required to be retained due to legal obligations will be kept for the periods specified in the relevant legislation.

thirdParties.title: Data Sharing & Third Parties
body: Your personal data may be shared with third parties in the following circumstances:
items: Cloud infrastructure service providers (server hosting)
Authentication service providers (Google OAuth)
AI model providers (anonymized/pseudonymized data for content generation)
Analytics service providers (anonymous usage data)
Legal authorities and regulatory bodies (when legally required)
Advertising and marketing partners (demographic data, interests, and usage habits may be shared for user profiling and targeted advertising purposes)

userRights.title: Data Subject Rights (KVKK Art. 11)
body: In accordance with Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the following rights:
items: Learning whether your personal data has been processed
Requesting information if your personal data has been processed
Learning the purpose of processing and whether data is used in accordance with its purpose
Knowing the third parties to whom personal data has been transferred domestically or abroad
Requesting correction of personal data if processed incompletely or inaccurately
Requesting deletion or destruction of personal data under the conditions set forth in Article 7 of the KVKK
Requesting notification of corrections or deletions to third parties to whom personal data has been transferred
Objecting to any adverse result arising from the analysis of processed data exclusively through automated systems
Claiming compensation for damages arising from unlawful processing of personal data
userRights.notice: Applications to exercise the rights listed above will be concluded within 30 days at the latest, following the completion of the identity verification process. If the transaction requires an additional cost, the tariff determined by the Personal Data Protection Board may apply.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
body: The following types of cookies are used on our website:
items: Essential Cookies: Required for basic site functionality (session management, language preference)
Analytics Cookies: Used to collect usage statistics (anonymized)
Preference Cookies: Used to store user preferences such as theme and language settings
cookiePolicy.notice: You can disable cookies through your browser settings; however, some platform features (such as session management, language and theme preferences) may not function properly. You can update your cookie preferences at any time.

contact.title: Contact
body: To exercise your rights under the KVKK, you can reach us through the following contact channels:
Please use "KVKK Information Request" as the subject line. Your application will be responded to within 30 days at the latest.
